worldcombat.skill.psyshieldbash.summary: Weave a shell of psychic energy around your whole body and ram in a chosen direction: the shell hardens your Defence the moment it forms (even on a miss or cast into empty space), and a landed slam deals contact damage and knocks the target back; your aim can stray.
worldcombat.skill.psyshieldbash.use.0: Ram with a shield and harden yourself at once
worldcombat.skill.psyshieldbash.use.1: Raise your Defence before you take a hit (even into empty space)
worldcombat.skill.psyshieldbash.use.2: Shove a target back with a thick shell
worldcombat.skill.psyshieldbash.descript: The slam deals about %1$s contact damage and shoves the target up to %2$s blocks along the charge; the shield has a %3$s block radius, and the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
Charge up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick, with up to %3$s degrees of stray; running into terrain or getting blocked stops the charge early.
Gain %1$s Defence stages when the shell forms, lasting %2$s. This applies whether or not you connect; the bonus ends with the shell, and recasting refreshes one layer.
worldcombat.skill.psyshieldbash.harden.o: Deep-weave form: a thicker shield with +2 Defence, but a lighter slam, a slower charge and a longer wind-up and cooldown.
Quick form: +1 Defence, a heavier hit and a faster charge with a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psyshieldbash.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.psyshieldbash.growth.0: At level %1$s, the slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.psyshieldbash.growth.1: At level %1$s, the slam power rises to %2$s and the shield duration to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.psyshieldbash.preferen: On: a thicker shield with +2 Defence, but a lighter slam, a slower charge and a longer wind-up and cooldown. Off: the quick form, +1 Defence, a heavier hit and a faster charge with a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of bashing. Larger values chase harder.
On: prefer this move while you are not yet shielded, to take the Defence first. Off: it only competes as an ordinary melee option.
